summary: Adjudicate 12 marketplace listing claims against FTC Green Guides / Amazon detail-page rules and local evidence, then rewrite the listing and build an evidence manifest. One folded check per claim (decision+reason+evidence) + setup_gate + 4 grouped deliverable checks + 5 LLM-judge quality checks = 22.

Every claim row carries a substantive rationale, and non-remove decisions carry replacement_text (deliverable completeness of claim_review.json).

Revised listing is compliant: required sections present, supported terms preserved, and all unsupported environmental/performance/platform-prohibited/wrong-scope terms removed with dishwasher scope narrowed to the top-rack lid.

Does revised_listing.md read like commercially usable marketplace copy while staying within the evidence boundaries for HPT-750-SS (not generic legal notes and not unsupported marketing exaggeration)?
Do the claim_review.json rationales explain the specific evidence boundary for each claim rather than giving generic one-line accept/reject explanations?
Are environmental and safety-related claims in the revised listing appropriately qualified according to the local FTC excerpt and component-specific certificates?
Are temperature, leak, dishwasher, and durability claims in the revised listing no stronger than the local lab evidence supports?
Does evidence_manifest.json connect the important review decisions to relevant local source files and concise evidence notes, rather than listing irrelevant sources?

check_strategy: private/expected_answer.json drives per-claim, per-dimension validation; the verifier computes the same atoms as before but folds emission per docs/check-granularity.md. Plumbing/coverage/enum → setup_gate (R2). Each claim = ONE check = AND(decision, reason_code, required_evidence), kept per-claim because claim adjudication at volume is the hard competency (R3a). summary counts, evidence manifest, claim_review completeness, and revised-listing edits each collapse to one same-skill capability check (R3). The 5 llm_judge_boolean quality checks stay separate (distinct judge rubrics, R4). Binary pass = all 22, identical to the old all-70 atoms (pure aggregation).
notes: Total checks = 22 (setup_gate + 12 per-claim + summary_counts_correct + evidence_manifest_quality + claim_review_completeness + revised_listing_correct + 5 llm_judge_boolean). Restructured 2026-06-08 from the previous 70-atom layout (20 structural + 12×3 per-claim + 9 listing/manifest + 5 LLM). Pure aggregation on the deterministic part: no validation loosened, binary pass unchanged; capacity now reflects distinct capability units. See docs/check-granularity.md.
